Careers

  1. Home
  2. About Us
  3. Careers

The European Fisheries Control Agency (EFCA) welcomes job applications from qualified professionals who are highly motivated to participate in the development of EFCA.

The agency is committed to diversity and inclusion, aiming to secure equal opportunities at every step of the career path, including selection and recruitment. It accepts applications without discrimination on the grounds of gender, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity, and from the broadest possible geographical basis among the EU Member States.

The agency follows the personnel policy of the staff regulations of officials and conditions of employment of other servants of the European Community and the European Atomic Energy Community, which is applicable at EU institutions and agencies. Successful candidates may be offered a post on the basis of these staff regulations. Jobs at EFCA are open to nationals of the Member States. Candidates are recruited on the condition that they have full rights as a citizen. Candidates must have fulfilled any obligations imposed on them by laws concerning military service and meet the requirements for the duties involved.

The agency has a limited number of temporary agent and contract agent posts, which are recruited through open selection procedures. Recruitment follows the standards of the EU institutions. EFCA may offer:

  • a three-year renewable contract for temporary agents;
  • a fixed-term renewable contract for contract agents.

Under the section "Vacancies" below, you can find links to current open calls for applications and past vacancies. Only applications for open vacancies will be considered. The vacancy notice details the conditions of the vacancy, the requirements, and the selection procedure.

Please take note of:

  • EFCA’s privacy statement in the context of selection and recruitment;
  • EFCA’s privacy statement in the context of written test supervision;
  • EFCA’s guidance on requests for information and appeal.

The agency offers a limited number of traineeships to candidates who successfully pass a selection process organised by the European Commission. You can find information on the traineeship scheme and how to apply on the blue book traineeship programme website. The privacy statement regarding the processing of personal data of trainees by EFCA can be found here.

  • Video – EFCA trainees' testimonials 

EFCA has launched a call for expressions of interest for the secondment of national experts to the agency, with the aim of establishing a pool of candidates for future needs. For further information on this call, please contact the permanent representation of your Member State. Links to the permanent representations of each Member State can be found here.

Important: Your application for a secondment to EFCA must be submitted by the permanent representation of the Member State that intends to second you. In addition, your application must contain:

  • a detailed curriculum vitae in the standard European format, which can be obtained here;
  • a duly completed and signed declaration of honour;
  • a motivation letter of no more than two pages.

EFCA aims to both create and maintain a supportive and healthy work environment that enables staff members to better balance their work and family lives and encourage a more equitable sharing of caring responsibilities between women and men.

Our work–life balance initiatives include:

  • flexible working hours;
  • teleworking;
  • holiday flexibility arrangements;
  • maternity leave;
  • parental leave;
  • part-time arrangements for breastfeeding.
